title: Descemet Membrane Endothelial Keratoplasty for Corneal Decompensation Secondary to Phakic Intraocular Lenses

groups.description: Corneal decompensation secondary to a phakic IOL (Artisan, I-Care or GBR/Vivarte): bilensectomy (pIOL explantation through a scleral tunnel and phacoemulsification with an in-the-bag IOL; one of the seven eyes of the series was left aphakic) followed by DMEK (Melles no-touch technique, 20% SF6 tamponade) 1-26 months later; two of the six eyes (patients 5 and 7) had the bilensectomy at another hospital. Patients 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 of Tables 1-2. Cataract surgery was not in the same session as DMEK (combined false). The article reports a 'Pre-op' BCVA without stating whether it was recorded before the bilensectomy or before DMEK (Table 1 grades cataract in the same preoperative data); follow-up months are counted from DMEK.

Corneal decompensation secondary to an Artisan phakic IOL treated by a quadruple procedure in one session: pIOL explantation, phacoemulsification, IOL implantation and DMEK (7 mm graft); patient 4 of Tables 1-2.

exclusions.what: BCVA group means (± SD) in the abstract and Results text
exclusions.reason: per-eye rows exist (protocol inclusion 4); the per-eye series are used
duplicates the preoperative BCVA of Table 2

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA cells printed '—' (patient 1 at 1 month, patient 3 at 1 and 3 months, patient 6 at 12 months)
Proportions of eyes reaching 20/32 or better (Discussion)

notes: Counting-finger vision is printed as 20/2000 (2 logMAR): the Figure 2 legend states that the preoperative 20/2000 of patient 2 was counting fingers; values are kept as printed.

Preoperative reference: Table 1 ('Preoperative data and surgical details') gives the pre-op BCVA together with the explanted pIOL and the cataract grade, and the Results state that cataractous changes were present in all eyes preoperatively; the article does not state when the pre-op BCVA was measured relative to the bilensectomy.
The Figure 2 legend prints 6-month acuities of patient 2 that differ slightly from Table 2; the Table 2 cells are cited.
UCVA, refraction at 12 months and endothelial cell density (Table 2) are mentioned here only; two eyes had YAG capsulotomy during follow-up.
